aboutHeading: 150 Years of Boat Building in Williamstown
aboutText: For 150 years, C Blunt Boat Builders has been launching wooden boats from Williamstown and Geelong into the waters of Port Phillip Bay. Now a listed heritage site run by a fifth generation of Blunts, we specialise in everything from sea-faring vessels to beautiful race-winning yachts. Our unique link to Victoria's maritime past ensures every project is built with care and tradition.
servicesText: At C Blunt Boat Builders, we offer a range of services from custom boat construction to meticulous restoration. With over a century of experience in Williamstown, we ensure every project meets the highest standards of quality and heritage craftsmanship.

services.title: Custom Wooden Boat Building
